title: ACE.Insight
description: Insight schema for ACE playbook system - distilled knowledge from reflections

id.description: Unique identifier for the insight (optional, can be auto-generated)

task.description: Task domain this insight applies to

insight_kind.description: Type of insight: rule (guideline), pattern (best practice), anti_pattern (what to avoid), checklist (steps)

insight_text.description: The actual insight content in imperative or descriptive form

tags.description: Tags for categorization and section routing (e.g., 'availability', 'payment', 'validation')

evidence_ref.description: Reference to source reflection or demonstration that produced this insight

novelty.description: Novelty score - how unique is this insight (0.0-1.0)

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when insight was created
